I've run into the same issue, as a workaround until the issue linked above is resolved, if you quantise to 4bit nf4 via bitsandbytes everything appears to work (as long as you use guidance scale 0.0 for the turbo model).

fwiw I did try load_in_8bit=True rather than 4bit but that runs into an error:

`RuntimeError: view size is not compatible with input tensor's size and stride (at least one dimension spans across two contiguous subspaces). Use .reshape(...) instead.`
